answer: The thread I would price into every new account is Optician eye test record with prescription history: eye tests at one optician with prescriptions on file, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because eye tests at one optician with prescriptions on file is bound to a single identity — the fable is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the yarrow for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
